explanation: This lemma only unfolds the library's own definition `peirceOneSub`, the Peirce subspace for eigenvalue 1 of an idempotent in a Euclidean Jordan algebra. Mathlib has no Euclidean Jordan algebras, so no Mathlib declaration can state membership in this subspace. The proof is `Iff.rfl`, so all of the lemma's content comes from the library's own definition. I did not search Mathlib further, since none of its declarations can refer to `peirceOneSub`.
